info.title: ByteAether.Ulid.Cli - Command Line Interface and .NET Tool for ULID
info.description: Official CLI companion tool and library for ByteAether.Ulid. Provides generation and inspection of Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers (ULIDs) with support for custom timestamps, time bytes, and random bytes, formatted for terminal and script interop.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: © Joonatan Uusväli, ByteAether. All rights reserved.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate one or more Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers (ULIDs).

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of ULIDs to generate when no ULID input is provided (default: 1).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for generated ULIDs: 'base32' (default), 'hex', or 'guid'.

options.name: --part
options.description: When inspecting, output only one component: 'ulid', 'hex', 'time', 'timeHex', 'timeIso', 'timestamp', 'random', or 'randomHex'.

options.name: --random
options.description: Custom 10 random bytes as a 20-character hex string, 16-character Crockford Base32 string, or separated byte values.

options.name: --time
options.description: Timestamp/time bytes for generated ULIDs. Accepts an ISO 8601 date string, Unix epoch milliseconds, 12-character hex time bytes, 10-character Crockford Base32 time bytes, or separated byte values.

arguments.name: ulid
arguments.description: ULID(s) to inspect. Accepts Crockford Base32, hex, or GUID format. Multiple values may also be piped via stdin, one per line.
